title: Prediction of dual NF-kappaB/IkappaB inhibitors using an integrative in-silico approaches.
authors: Abbasi, Maryam; Mahboubi-Rabbani, Mohammad; Kashfi, Khosrow; Sadeghi-Aliabadi, Hojjat
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过虚拟筛选、对接和MD模拟预测NF-kappaB/IkappaB双抑制剂，但对象为蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法虽含AI/物理模拟但与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Multiple lines of evidence indicate that the NF-kappaB signaling pathway plays a pivotal role in carcinogenesis; activation of NF-kappaB in cancer increases cell proliferation and suppresses apoptosis, both of which define tumor mass development. Inhibiting NF-kappaB leads to tumor suppression by blocking the IKK-alpha/beta enzymes, thus inhibiting its translocation. Furthermore, protecting p65 from acetylation and phosphorylation inhibits NF-kappaB through its active site. Some small molecules are assumed to inhibit NF-kappaB and IkappaB function separately. This study took one of the previously reported NF-kappaB inhibitors (compound D4) as a promising lead and predicted some dual NF-kappaB and IkappaB inhibitors. We performed a virtual screening (VS) workflow on a library with 186,146 compounds with 75% similarity to compound D4 on both NF-kappaB and IkappaB proteins. A total of 186 compounds were extracted from three steps of VS 36 were common in both proteins. These compounds were subjected to the quantum polarized ligand docking to elect potent compounds with the highest binding affinity for NF-kappaB and IkappaB proteins. The MM-GBSA method calculates the lowest binding free energy for eight selected compounds. These analyses found three top-ranked compounds for each protein with suitable pharmacokinetics properties and higher in-silico inhibitory ability. In the last screening, compound CID_4969 was introduced to a molecular dynamics (MDs) simulation study as a common inhibitor for both proteins. The MDs confirmed the main interactions between the final elected compound and NF-kappaB/IkappaB proteins. Consequently, the presented computational approaches could be used for designing promising anti-cancer agents.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 多条证据表明，NF-kappaB信号通路在致癌过程中扮演关键角色；癌症中NF-kappaB的激活增加细胞增殖并抑制凋亡，这两者共同决定了肿瘤团块的发展。抑制NF-kappaB通过阻断IKK-alpha/beta酶来抑制其转位，从而导致肿瘤抑制。此外，保护p65免受乙酰化和磷酸化修饰，可通过其活性位点抑制NF-kappaB。一些小型分子被认为分别抑制NF-kappaB和IkappaB的功能。本研究选取了先前报道的一种NF-kappaB抑制剂（化合物D4）作为有前景的先导化合物，并预测了一些双重NF-kappaB和IkappaB抑制剂。我们在一个包含186,146个化合物、与化合物D4有75%相似度的库中，对NF-kappaB和IkappaB蛋白进行了虚拟筛选（VS）流程。通过三步VS共提取出186个化合物，其中36个在两种蛋白中均常见。这些化合物经过量子极化配体对接，以选出对NF-kappaB和IkappaB蛋白具有最高结合亲和力的有效化合物。MM-GBSA方法计算了八个选定化合物的最低结合自由能。这些分析发现，每种蛋白有三个排名靠前的化合物，具有合适的药代动力学特性和更高的计算机模拟抑制能力。在最后筛选中，化合物CID_4969被引入分子动力学（MDs）模拟研究，作为两种蛋白的常见抑制剂。MDs确认了最终选定化合物与NF-kappaB/IkappaB蛋白之间的主要相互作用。因此，所提出的计算方法可用于设计有前景的抗癌药物。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
